items.name: icon-trail-button
items.title: Icon Trail Button
items.description: A pill button whose icon pill expands on hover or focus, playing out a staggered chevron trail before it parks. CSS transitions and a small state machine — no animation library.

items.name: icon-trail-button-demo
items.title: Icon Trail Button Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Icon Trail Button.

items.name: sliding-tabs
items.title: Sliding Tabs
items.description: A pill nav whose lime indicator scales in under the first tab, then slides to follow the pointer or keyboard focus. Leaving the nav returns it to the active tab.

items.name: sliding-tabs-demo
items.title: Sliding Tabs Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Sliding Tabs.

items.name: avatar-reveal
items.title: Avatar Reveal
items.description: Three stacked avatars that scale and unblur in from the left on an elastic ease, then a caption slides in from the right.

items.name: avatar-reveal-demo
items.title: Avatar Reveal Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Avatar Reveal.

items.name: auth-modal
items.title: Auth Modal
items.description: A login modal: the backdrop fades, the panel scales up, then the close button, title, sign-in providers and email field stagger in. Closing plays the sequence in reverse.

items.name: auth-modal-demo
items.title: Auth Modal Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Auth Modal.

items.name: number-counter
items.title: Number Counter
items.description: An animated stats counter whose digits spin up once when the stat scrolls into view. ScrollTrigger fires it, Number Flow handles the count.

items.name: number-counter-demo
items.title: Number Counter Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Number Counter.

items.name: voice-sample-player
items.title: Voice Sample Player
items.description: An audio player pill: press play and the name slides away, a lime waveform equalizer slides in and starts oscillating, and the icon morphs to pause. Pass a src to play real audio.

items.name: voice-sample-player-demo
items.title: Voice Sample Player Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Voice Sample Player.

items.name: flip-card
items.title: Flip Card
items.description: A card that flips in 3D on hover or tap — the front rotates out while the back rotates in with its description, feature list and CTA staggering into place.

items.name: flip-card-demo
items.title: Flip Card Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Flip Card.

items.name: faq-accordion
items.title: FAQ Accordion
items.description: A single-open accordion that animates its height open while the answer reveals line by line through a SplitText mask and the icon morphs from plus to minus.

items.name: faq-accordion-demo
items.title: FAQ Accordion Demo
items.description: Usage examples for FAQ Accordion.

items.name: shiny-button
items.title: Shiny Button
items.description: A pill button with a diagonal light sweep that glides across on hover while the leading sparkle twinkles. Pure CSS — no GSAP dependency.

items.name: shiny-button-demo
items.title: Shiny Button Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Shiny Button.

items.name: text-roll-button
items.title: Text Roll Button
items.description: A pill button whose label rolls up character by character on hover — the current text lifts out the top as a fresh copy rolls in from below, on a fine per-character stagger.

items.name: text-roll-button-demo
items.title: Text Roll Button Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Text Roll Button.

items.name: slide-arrow-button
items.title: Slide Arrow Button
items.description: A pill button whose label rolls up on hover while the chevron slides out of its lime badge and a fresh one slides in from the left. Pure CSS — no GSAP dependency.

items.name: slide-arrow-button-demo
items.title: Slide Arrow Button Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Slide Arrow Button.

items.name: glow-button
items.title: Glow Button
items.description: A pill button floating over a soft red, amber, violet and cyan glow that sharpens as the button lifts and a chevron slides through its slot. Pure CSS — no GSAP dependency.

items.name: glow-button-demo
items.title: Glow Button Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Glow Button.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: A pill button pulled toward the cursor once it comes near, its label drifting a little further for parallax depth, then easing back to rest when the cursor leaves the field.

items.name: magnetic-button-demo
items.title: Magnetic Button Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Magnetic Button.

items.name: dot-bloom-button
items.title: Dot Bloom Button
items.description: A button whose leading dot blooms into a fill that floods the whole surface on hover, while the label rolls up to a fresh copy and flips to the contrasting color.

items.name: dot-bloom-button-demo
items.title: Dot Bloom Button Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Dot Bloom Button.

items.name: logo-orbit
items.title: Logo Orbit
items.description: Logos spaced evenly around a ring that rotates continuously, each mark counter-rotated so it always stays upright. Hover pauses the orbit.

items.name: logo-orbit-demo
items.title: Logo Orbit Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Logo Orbit.

items.name: logo-cycle
items.title: Logo Cycle
items.description: A logo row that holds a fixed count and cycles the extras: the current set staggers up and blurs out as the next slides in from below. Hover pauses the loop.

items.name: logo-cycle-demo
items.title: Logo Cycle Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Logo Cycle.

items.name: logo-wave
items.title: Logo Wave
items.description: An endless logo strip where the mark nearest the midpoint rises and scales up while its neighbors step down into a wave. Hover pauses the marquee.

items.name: logo-wave-demo
items.title: Logo Wave Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Logo Wave.

items.name: image-fan-slider
items.title: Image Fan Slider
items.description: An image gallery slider: a fan of photos that auto-advances — the active one large and sharp, its neighbors rotated and blurred on each side. Hover pauses. Pure CSS transitions.

items.name: image-fan-slider-demo
items.title: Image Fan Slider Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Image Fan Slider.

items.name: morphing-text
items.title: Morphing Text
items.description: A headline text animation whose last word cycles through a list with a gooey blur morph — an SVG alpha threshold fuses the outgoing and incoming words into one liquid shape while the slot eases between word widths.

items.name: morphing-text-demo
items.title: Morphing Text Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Morphing Text.

items.name: wordmark-reveal
items.title: Wordmark Reveal
items.description: A display wordmark text reveal that assembles itself on the first scroll — every letter turns in on its own vertical axis, then a script line leans in along the baseline. A cue holds the screen until you answer it, or it plays on mount with `instant`. ScrollTrigger and SplitText.

items.name: wordmark-reveal-demo
items.title: Wordmark Reveal Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Wordmark Reveal.

items.name: pricing-plan-switch
items.title: Pricing Plan Switch
items.description: A pricing section where picking a plan morphs the name badge, crossfades the description and spins the price with Number Flow, while the checklist lights up its included rows. A monthly/yearly toggle re-spins the price.

items.name: pricing-plan-switch-demo
items.title: Pricing Plan Switch Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Pricing Plan Switch.

items.name: process-card-reveal
items.title: Process Card Reveal
items.description: Numbered steps on a timeline whose connector fills before the next card slides and blurs into place — image one way, copy the other. Hover pauses the loop; clicking a step jumps there.

items.name: process-card-reveal-demo
items.title: Process Card Reveal Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Process Card Reveal.

items.name: process-sticky-steps
items.title: Process Sticky Steps

items.description: Usage examples for Process Sticky Steps.

items.name: strip-wipe
items.title: Strip Wipe

items.title: Rating Carousel Demo

items.description: Usage examples for CTA Image Fan.

items.title: CTA Photo Headline Demo
items.description: Usage examples for CTA Photo Headline.

items.description: Usage examples for Blog Hover Expand.

items.description: Usage examples for Card Hover Expand.

items.description: Usage examples for Card Spotlight Grid.

items.name: column-drift

items.description: Usage examples for Column Drift.

items.title: Logo Wall Shuffle Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Logo Wall Shuffle.

items.name: testimonial-line-sweep-demo
items.title: Testimonial Line Sweep Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Testimonial Line Sweep.

items.name: cta-starfall

items.name: cta-starfall-demo
items.title: CTA Starfall Demo
items.description: Usage examples for CTA Starfall.

items.name: pricing-usage-slider

items.name: pricing-usage-slider-demo
items.title: Pricing Usage Slider Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Pricing Usage Slider.

items.name: grid-cascade-demo

items.description: Usage examples for Grid Cascade.

items.name: shutter-slider-demo

items.description: Usage examples for Shutter Slider.

items.name: testimonial-reel-focus-demo
items.title: Testimonial Reel Focus Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Testimonial Reel Focus.

items.name: kinetic-type-ring

items.description: Usage examples for Kinetic Type Ring.

items.name: footer-wordmark-rise-demo
items.title: Footer Wordmark Rise Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Footer Wordmark Rise.

items.name: loader-iris-ring-demo

items.description: Usage examples for Loader Iris Ring.

items.title: Testimonial Ring

items.title: Testimonial Ring Demo
items.description: Usage examples for Testimonial Ring.
